title: Sledding Game
genre: Multiplayer social hangout / casual physics sledding sandbox ('friendslop' co-op)
release_date: 2026-04-30 (Early Access launch on Steam, Xbox Series X|S / Xbox PC and PC Game Pass simultaneously) [CONFIRMED – Steam store / GamesRadar / Wikipedia]
early_access_date: 2026-04-30 (still in Early Access as of 2026-10-08; dev plans up to ~12 months in EA) [CONFIRMED – Steam store FAQ / GamesRadar]. Free demo launched 2025-09-26 [CONFIRMED – SteamDB demo app 4029310]
window_note: in window (EA launch 2026-04-30; viral demo Sept 2025)
developer: Max (Maximilian Porter) trading as 'The Sledding Corporation' (also reported as 'The Sledding Company')
team_size: 1 core developer (solo) + outsourced/credited music and logo [CONFIRMED – GamesRadar 2026-05-07: 'bulk of the game was made by one developer who goes by Max'; Steam credits list music and logo by others]
country: United States [per Wikipedia 'Sledding Game' article; not independently confirmed by the dev]
developer_background: First ever video game ('Sledding Game is my first ever video game!' – dev on Steam page). Began as a personal side project; per WN Hub he started work just over a month before the Steam page went live (mid-January 2025), i.e. ~early December 2024, and started posting funny gameplay clips / devlogs on TikTok from December 2024. Says the sales let him continue making games full time [CONFIRMED – dev Steam post via Notebookcheck].
publisher: self-published (The Sledding Corporation); Xbox / PC Game Pass day-one deal (terms undisclosed)
platforms_and_store_links: Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3438850/Sledding_Game/ ; Steam demo: app 4029310 ; Xbox / PC Game Pass: https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/_/9N9C1TB18R3B (no Steam–Xbox crossplay per a June 2026 review)
business_model: Premium Early Access $7.99 [CONFIRMED – Steam store]; seen discounted 38% to $4.95 (launch/seasonal) and 20% to $6.39 [CONFIRMED – Steam store snapshots]; also in PC Game Pass (subscription deal, undisclosed). Final full-release price 'yet to be determined' (Steam FAQ).
units_or_downloads: 100,000+ copies in 5 days (by 2026-05-05) [CONFIRMED – dev Steam news post, via GamesRadar/Notebookcheck/Niche Gamer]. Current (Oct 2026): ~150,000–195,000 Steam units [ESTIMATE – calibrated Boxleiter: ~2,420 reviews × implied ratio ~62 ≈ 150k; SteamPulse 194,435 units (2026-10-08); VG Insights ~185k units (170k paid)]. Xbox store sales and Game Pass plays not included. Demo: 120,000+ players in first week (Sept 2025) [reported by press, dev-sourced].
peak_concurrent_players: Full game: ~3,213–3,262 all-time peak on 2026-05-03 [ESTIMATE – Tracker.gg 3,213; SteamBase 3,262; SteamPulse tracked peak 1,958 is a partial-window floor]. Demo (app 4029310): 5,616 all-time peak on 2025-09-27 [CONFIRMED – SteamDB]. Current: ~55–142 CCU (Oct 2026) [ESTIMATE – SteamPulse/SteamBase snapshots].
steam_reviews: 1,600+ reviews, 97% positive on ~2026-05-05/07 [Notebookcheck/GamesRadar]; ~2,400–2,420 reviews, 96–97% positive 'Overwhelmingly Positive' on ~2026-10-08 [Steam store via search snapshot; SteamPulse 2,419 @ 97%]; recent 30-day 89% of ~97 reviews.
implied_review_multiplier: ~62 (100,000 confirmed units ÷ ~1,600 reviews around 2026-05-05). Notable: cheap ($7.99, often $4.95), social/multi-pack purchase pattern → high ratio, in line with spec's 50–60+ for cheap viral co-op.
gross_revenue: ~$0.75M–$1.0M Steam gross to date, central ~$0.85M [ESTIMATE – ~150k–195k units × ~$5.00 average realised price (list $7.99 × 0.75 = $5.99, reduced because a 38% discount to $4.95 ran at/near launch)]. Trackers: VG Insights ~$806k; SteamPulse ~$862k (2026-10-08). Excludes Xbox store sales and the Game Pass deal fee (undisclosed, could be material).
net_revenue: ~$0.49M–$0.64M, central ~$0.55M [ESTIMATE – gross × (1 − 30% Steam cut, under $10M tier) × 0.93 refunds]; self-published so no publisher split; plus undisclosed Game Pass payment.
production_cost: ~$100k opportunity cost [ESTIMATE – 1 person × ~17 months (Dec 2024 → Apr 2026) × $6k/month US lean-indie rate; likely worked unpaid/part-time as a side project] + small outsourced music/logo spend (no data; likely low $k). No paid marketing reported.
development_time: ~17 months to Early Access (started ~early Dec 2024; Steam page mid-Jan 2025; demo 2025-09-26; EA 2026-04-30) [ESTIMATE – derived from WN Hub (dev's posts: work began just over a month before the Steam page went up) and release dates]; EA roadmap up to 12 more months.
why_popular: Instantly readable, funny hook: cute low-poly animals (frogs, penguins, polar bears) ragdolling down snowy hills. Pure low-stakes 'hangout' game in the Webfishing mould – proximity voice chat, cosmetics, minigames, large lobbies (stated goal up to 50, early talk of 100) – ideal for friend groups and streamers. Physics mishaps are inherently clippable, feeding short-form video. Very cheap ($7.99, $4.95 on discount) so groups buy together. Overwhelmingly Positive reviews and the 'solo dev first game' story drove press coverage.
marketing_channels: Build-in-public devlogs on TikTok, YouTube and Instagram from Dec 2024 (millions of views; one Instagram clip 2.3M views) → 15.8k wishlists day 1 and 80k in first week of Steam page (Jan 2025, dev-reported via WN Hub); viral free multiplayer demo (Sept 2025; 120k+ players, topped Steam free charts, +45k–80k wishlists in a week); Raijin estimates ~234k wishlists (2026-09-05); streamers/YouTubers; Xbox/Game Pass day-one exposure; press coverage of the solo-dev milestone (GamesRadar, Notebookcheck, Niche Gamer). Next Fest participation reports conflict.
engine: Unity [CONFIRMED – dev statement on Steam; Unity Awards 'Most Anticipated' nominee; MobyGames/SteamDB tech info]
art_style: Stylised low-poly 3D, bright snowy palette, cute customisable animal characters with ragdoll physics; comedic, toy-like.
ai_feasibility_justification: AI can: write most gameplay code (sled/ragdoll physics controller, Steam lobby networking boilerplate, cosmetics/inventory, UI), generate low-poly animal and prop models (Meshy/Tripo + cleanup), textures, SFX and chill music, store copy. | AI cannot: nail the slide 'feel' and ragdoll comedy, tune netcode for big lobbies (sync of 20–50 physics players + proximity voice pushes toward score 3), decide what is funny/clippable, playtest, or replicate 17 months of consistent short-form devlog marketing and community building, which drove this hit. | Toolset: Claude Code + Unity 6 (or Godot 4) + Steamworks lobbies with FishNet/Netcode for GameObjects or Photon Fusion, Dissonance/Vivox or Steam voice for proximity chat, Meshy/Tripo + Blender for animals, Scenario/Midjourney for UI/icons, ElevenLabs SFX, Suno/Udio music.
solo_ai_mvp_cost_time: 5–8 weeks, ~$300–$800 (Claude Pro/Max, 3D-gen + audio subs for 2 months, $100 Steam Direct, a few asset packs). Excludes developer living costs.
solo_ai_polished_cost_time: 6–12 months, ~$3,000–$10,000 (tool subs, character/rigging polish freelancer, composer or licensed music, logo/capsule art, playtests, small ad/creator budget, voice-chat middleware tier). Excludes developer living costs; the real cost is the months of consistent TikTok/YouTube devlogging.

data_conflicts: Peak CCU: Tracker.gg 3,213 vs SteamBase 3,262 (both 2026-05-03) vs SteamPulse 'tracked' 1,958 (partial window) – used ~3.2k; the demo's 5,616 (SteamDB) is higher than the full game's peak (Game Pass split the PC audience). Units: trackers 185k–194k vs calibrated Boxleiter ~150k – reported a range. Wishlists: 80k in first week of Steam page (Jan 2025, dev) vs 'over 200,000' (secondary) vs Raijin ~234k estimate (Sept 2026); demo-week wishlist gain 45k (SweMOD) vs 80k (other report). Studio name 'The Sledding Corporation' vs 'The Sledding Company'. Lobby size 50 (store, 'unconfirmed goal') vs 100 (early press). Next Fest Feb 2026 participation: dev post says no, some press says yes. Raijin lists $0 gross (low confidence) – ignored.
notes: Low peak CCU (~3k) relative to ~100k+ units shows hangout games are played in small friend sessions and that the Game Pass deal pulled part of the audience off Steam. Strong template for a solo creator: one funny physics verb + animals + social hangout + daily short-form devlogs from day one + cheap price. The Steam page went up only ~1 month into development to capture wishlists from the viral clips. Real money likely also includes an undisclosed Microsoft Game Pass payment.
